name: svelte-vscode
description: Svelte language support for VS Code
readme:
# Svelte for VS Code

Svelte language support from the Svelte team, powered by the Svelte language server: highlighting, diagnostics of the script and the markup, completion of components, their props and events, navigation across `.svelte` and `.ts` files. The language server, the Svelte compiler and TypeScript are bundled, nothing else to install.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

## What works in Diode

Everything the language server drives in `.svelte` files: problems from the Svelte compiler and TypeScript, completion with the import of the component, hover, F12, Go to Implementation and Type Definition, references, rename (an imported name is renamed through an alias in the import, as in VS Code), outline and workspace symbols, occurrences, call hierarchy and linked editing of a paired tag (`editor.linkedEditing`). Inlay hints and the references code lens follow the TypeScript settings, as in VS Code: `typescript.inlayHints.*` and `typescript.referencesCodeLens.enabled`. The commands Show Compiled Code, Extract Component and Restart Language Server work from the command palette.

## What does not

The TypeScript plugin of the extension is not loaded: `.ts` and `.js` files do not see the props of a Svelte component they import, and a rename in a `.ts` file does not reach `.svelte` files. The extension asks to enable it; any answer is safe, and the built-in TypeScript keeps working. The snippets of the extension are not offered: Diode does not load extension snippets yet.

works: Highlighting, and diagnostics of the script and the markup from the Svelte compiler and TypeScript
Completion of components, their props and events, with the import of the component; hover
Go to definition, implementation and type definition and references across .svelte and .ts files; rename of props across .svelte files
Inlay hints and the references code lens by the TypeScript settings, outline and workspace symbols, occurrences, call hierarchy and linked editing of a paired tag
Show Compiled Code, Extract Component and Restart Language Server from the command palette
limits: The TypeScript plugin is not loaded: .ts and .js files do not see the props of the Svelte components they import, and a rename in a .ts file does not reach .svelte files
